title: Tin Ore
wikitext:
'''Tin Ore''' is the second-easiest [[ore]] to [[mining|mine]]. It is mined from [[Tin Vein]]s. You need 65 [[mining]] skill to mine it. It's mostly used to create the metal alloy [[Bronze Bar|Bronze]].
